channel.description: Recent content in +०४-चित्रकूट-प्राप्तिः on रामायणे विश्वासटिप्पन्यः

item.title: ०४५ तमसातीरगमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Rama requests the citizens to return to Ayodhya and to show respect to Bharata the prince Regent and Dasaratha the king. The citizens try to persuade Rama to return to Ayodhya, but in vain. Rama along with all of them reach the bank of Tamasa.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका पुरवासियोंसे भरत और महाराज दशरथके प्रति प्रेम-भाव रखनेका अनुरोध करते हुए लौट जानेके लिये कहना; नगरके वृद्ध ब्राह्मणोंका श्रीरामसे लौट चलनेके लिये आग्रह करना तथा उन सबके साथ श्रीरामका तमसातटपर पहुँचना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Though Daśaratha has been turned back, the devoted citizens of Ayodhyā refuse to leave Rāma’s chariot; gazing on them as on his own children, Rāma begs them to bestow their love and honour upon Bharata.

item.title: ०४६ पौरान् विहाय रामादीनां गमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Having reached the banks of Tamasa river and thinking of the plight of the people of Ayodhya, Rama passes the night on the banks of Tamasa river. Waking up in the meantime, Rama instructs the charioteer to drive the chariot in such a way as to elude the citizens and lead them to think that the chariot had turned back towards Ayodhya instead of proceeding towards the forest. He then ascends the chariot along with Sita and Lakshmana and went ahead to the forest.

भागसूचना
  1. सीता और लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका रात्रिमें तमसा-तटपर निवास, माता-पिता और अयोध्याके लिये चिन्ता तथा पुरवासियोंको सोते छोड़कर वनकी ओर जाना

item.title: ०४७ पौरप्रत्यागमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

The multitude that had caused Rama in his journey to the forest wake up to find Rama and his associates gone. They begin to rebuke themselves. Overwhelmed with grief, they hunt up to tracks of Rama’s chariot. Being unable to find the tracks, they helplessly return to Ayodhya in sheer despair.

भागसूचना
  1. प्रातःकाल उठनेपर पुरवासियोंका विलाप करना और निराश होकर नगरको लौटना

item.title: ०४८ शोकमग्ना-अयोध्या
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Informed by the citizens of Rama’s departure for the forest, when they returned to Ayodhya after being unable to find out the tracks of his chariot, the wives of the citizens reproach Kaikeyi and break into lamentation.

भागसूचना
  1. नगरनिवासिनी स्त्रियोंका विलाप करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Returning to Ayodhyā with their life-breaths nearly departed, the citizens weep in their homes as commerce and hearth-fires cease and wives reproach their husbands like elephants goaded with hooks.

item.title: ०४९ रामादिभिः गोमत्यादिनदीतरणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Having traveled for a pretty long distance, Rama crossed Vedasruti, Gomati and Syandika rivers. He presses forward in the chariot talking with Sumantra.

भागसूचना
  1. ग्रामवासियोंकी बातें सुनते हुए श्रीरामका कोसल जनपदको लाँघते हुए आगे जाना और वेदश्रुति, गोमती एवं स्यन्दिका नदियोंको पार करके सुमन्त्रसे कुछ कहना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Travelling far during the remainder of the night and worshipping the morning twilight, Rāma speeds past ploughed village borders and flowering woods while hearing countryfolk denounce Daśaratha and Kaikeyī.

item.title: ०५० गङ्गातीरे गुहसमागमः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Rama bids farewell to his birth-place Ayodhya and reaches the bank of the holy Ganga. There, Nishadas offers welcome reception to Rama and others.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका मार्गमें अयोध्यापुरीसे वनवासकी आज्ञा माँगना और शृङ्गवेरपुरमें गङ्गातटपर पहुँचकर रात्रिमें निवास करना, वहाँ निषादराज गुहद्वारा उनका सत्कार
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Turning back toward Ayodhyā at the border of Kosala with joined palms, Rāma bids farewell to the capital and its guardian deities and gently dismisses the weeping countryfolk.

item.title: ०५१ गुह-लक्ष्मणसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Guha requests Lakshmana to take rest, duly expressing his readiness to guard Rama and his consort by keeping awake the whole night. Lakshmana expressed his unwillingness to lie down in the presence of his elder brother and sister in law and preferred to remain awake. He spends night talking with Guha, voicing grief for his royal father as well as his affectionate mothers.

भागसूचना
  1. निषादराज गुहके समक्ष लक्ष्मणका विलाप

item.title: ०५२ गङ्गातरणम्-सुमन्त्रविसर्जनं च
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

As per instructions of Rama, Guha gets a boat ready. Sumantra requests Rama to take him as a personal attendant to the forest, but Rama declines his offer and after reasoning with him, sends him back to Ayodhya. Rama and Lakshmana matted their hair with the latex of a banyan tree procured by Guha. On reaching the middle of the stream, Sita offers prayers to Mother Ganga (the deity presiding over the stream) and after crossing the river, all the three halt for the night at the foot of a tree.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे गुहका नाव मँगाना, श्रीरामका सुमन्त्रको समझा-बुझाकर अयोध्यापुरी लौट जानेके लिये आज्ञा देना और माता-पिता आदिसे कहनेके लिये संदेश सुनाना, सुमन्त्रके वनमें ही चलनेके लिये आग्रह करनेपर श्रीरामका उन्हें युक्तिपूर्वक समझाकर लौटनेके लिये विवश करना, फिर तीनोंका नावपर बैठना,सीताकी गङ्गाजीसे प्रार्थना, नावसे पार उतरकर श्रीराम आदिका वत्सदेशमें पहुँचना और सायंकालमें एक वृक्षके नीचे रहनेके लिये जाना

item.title: ०५३ राम-लक्ष्मणसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Rama tries to send Lakshmana back to Ayodhya, apprehending trouble for Kousalya and others in the hands of Kaikeyi. Lakshmana however refuses to return to Ayodhya, pleasing his inability to survive in the absence of Rama. Rama thereafter agrees again for Lakshmana’s stay in the forest with him.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका राजाको उपालम्भ देते हुए कैकेयीसे कौसल्या आदिके अनिष्टकी आशङ्का बताकर लक्ष्मणको अयोध्या लौटानेके लिये प्रयत्न करना, लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामके बिना अपना जीवन असम्भव बताकर वहाँ जानेसे इनकार करना, फिर श्रीरामका उन्हें वनवासकी अनुमति देना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Halting beneath the great banyan tree in the Vatsa country and performing his evening twilight devotions, Rāma counsels Lakṣmaṇa on their nightly vigil over Sītā and reflects upon Daśaratha’s grief and Kaikeyī’s triumph.

item.title: ०५४ भरद्वाजाश्रमगमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Rama, Seetha and Lakshmana reach the hermitage of Bharadwaja, situated a the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna rivers. The sage Bharadwaja extends hospitality to them and recommends Chitrakuta as the fittest place for them to sojourn in. Spending the night in discourses on various matters with him, the sage grants him leave early next morning to depart for Chitrakuta.

भागसूचना
  1. लक्ष्मण और सीतासहित श्रीरामका प्रयागमें गङ्गा-यमुना-संगमके समीप भरद्वाज-आश्रममें जाना, मुनिके द्वारा उनका अतिथि सत्कार, उन्हें चित्रकूट पर्वतपर ठहरनेका आदेश तथा चित्रकूटकी महत्ता एवं शोभाका वर्णन

item.title: ०५५ यमुनातरणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Sage Bharadwaja informs the route by which Rama and Lakshmana can reach Chitrakuta. They cross the River Yamuna by a raft prepared by themselves. Seetha prays the River Yamuna and a fig tree called Syama. The three of them traveled for a couple of miles along the bank of Yamuna, strolling in the charming forest and reach a leveled ground on the bank to take rest for the night.

भागसूचना
  1. भरद्वाजजीका श्रीराम आदिके लिये स्वस्तिवाचन करके उन्हें चित्रकूटका मार्ग बताना, उन सबका अपने ही बनाये हुए बेड़ेसे यमुनाजीको पार करना, सीताकी यमुना और श्यामवटसे प्रार्थना, तीनोंका यमुनाके किनारेके मार्गसे एक कोसतक जाकर वनमें घूमना-फिरना, यमुनाजीके समतल तटपर रात्रिमें निवास करना

item.title: ०५६ चित्रकूटदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book II : Ayodhya Kanda - Book Of Ayodhya

Seetha, Rama and Lakshmana reach the mountain of Chitrakuta, beholding and showing one another the grandeur of the woods there. They visit the hermitage of sage Valmiki. Lakshmana builds a leaf-hut upon instructions from Rama. All of them enter the hut, after performing purification ceremony.

भागसूचना
  1. वनकी शोभा देखते-दिखाते हुए श्रीराम आदिका चित्रकूटमें पहुँचना, वाल्मीकिजीका दर्शन करके श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे लक्ष्मणद्वारा पर्णशालाका निर्माण तथा उसकी वास्तुशान्ति करके उन सबका कुटीमें प्रवेश
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Awakening the sleeping Lakṣmaṇa at dawn as woodland birds sing sweetly, Rāma performs his morning ablutions in the Yamunā with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa and points out the blazing crimson kiṃśuka blossoms along the path to Citrakūṭa.
